The Junonia Experience

An approach built on understanding, not assumptions.

We slow the conversation down, see the whole picture and design a strategy you can understand—with the right people alongside you.

What we believe

Before we discuss the numbers, we get to know you.

Tom's starting point is simple: a financial decision should make sense in the context of the life it affects.

We want to understand who depends on you, what keeps you up at night, the lifestyle you hope to lead and what you want to leave behind. Then we look at the financial tools that may help.

Solutions

The next chapter brings different questions.
We help you answer them.

From turning savings into income to protecting loved ones, we coordinate decisions so the pieces work together.

What we help you think through

A complete picture, not a collection of products.

The exact solution depends on your circumstances, priorities, eligibility and the professionals involved.

01Retirement-income strategy+
Explore how savings, retirement accounts, pensions, Social Security and potential income-producing products might work together. The goal is a plan you understand and can revisit as circumstances change.
02Market and withdrawal risk+
Discuss the risks associated with taking withdrawals during market declines, the impact of timing, and ways to make your retirement income more resilient. All strategies have benefits, limits and trade-offs.
03Protection and insurance+
Consider life insurance, disability, long-term-care needs and other protection topics through appropriately licensed professionals when relevant to the plan.
04Investment coordination+
Bring investment-focused professionals into conversations when portfolio matters require additional expertise, while keeping income goals and other planning needs in view.
05Spouse, family and legacy+
Make room for survivor-income concerns, beneficiary decisions, estate-planning coordination and the people who may rely on your plan.
06Business and other needs+
When more specialized situations arise, we can help connect conversations with the relevant professionals, subject to availability and any required approvals.

Retirement-income strategy

Tom Bell

Strategic direction and client relationships

After 22 years at AT&T, Tom experienced firsthand what can happen when a major retirement-income source changes unexpectedly. It reshaped how he thinks about planning, risk and protecting the people behind the numbers.

Today, he focuses on the income decisions facing families approaching or living in retirement. He listens, helps clarify the bigger picture and brings in other professionals where their expertise can add value.

Client experience and operations

Elisa Enriquez

Coordination, delivery and relationship continuity

Elisa turns strategy into an experience clients can navigate. She helps coordinate the administrative details, organizes the team and keeps the process moving from the first conversation through follow-up.

She is also central to Junonia's long-term continuity, helping build a service model that can support clients and families over time.

Specialist collaboration

The right expertise for each part of your life.

When your needs go beyond income strategy, Junonia can coordinate with other professionals instead of asking you to manage every introduction and handoff on your own.

The specific team and services involved depend on the case, licensing, availability and required approvals.

The story behind the name

Some lessons stay with us.
They shape what comes next.

For Tom Bell, personal experience became a reason to help others make retirement-income decisions with greater care.

The turning point

When an expected source of income changed, everything felt different.

After a 22-year career at AT&T, Tom took early retirement to pursue nonprofit work supporting men facing addiction. He had relied heavily on AT&T dividend income. When that income was sharply reduced, he felt the vulnerability that a concentrated strategy can create.

That experience is part of why he cares so deeply about helping people understand where their retirement income will come from and how their plan might respond when circumstances change.

What the name means

The rare shell that became a promise of attention.

The Junonia is a sought-after shell found on the shores of Sanibel Island. People remember the moment they find one. The name speaks to the kind of understanding and personal care Tom hopes people remember about working with his team.

A good relationship is part of a good financial plan.

What's ahead

The future of Junonia is a stronger team.

Tom's vision extends beyond his own practice. Together with Elisa, he's building a collaborative model that can give clients access to specialized expertise and a lasting relationship.

What to expect

A few common questions

Do I need to have everything organized first?

No. Come prepared to talk about your goals and what you want to better understand. The team can explain which information would be useful next.

Does Junonia work only with retirees?

Retirement-income planning is the primary focus. The firm may also serve younger professionals and families where the needs and professional services are a fit.

Will I work directly with Tom?

Tom plays a central role in income strategy and client relationships, while other professionals may contribute depending on your planning needs.

How do I book a meeting?
